pickup_address.label: Pickup address + appointment or FCFS window

Checked_in_at_shipper.description: Whether the driver has already checked in at the shipper

Confirmed_equipment.description: Whether the driver confirmed they have the correct tractor, trailer, and required equipment

Door_number.description: The door number assigned to the driver, or 'waiting' if not yet assigned

Driver_name_confirmed.description: The confirmed name of the driver

ETA_to_shipper.description: Estimated time of arrival to the shipper, or 'checked in' if already there

Is_assigned_driver.description: Whether the person on the call is the driver assigned to the load

Offloading_location.description: City and state where driver is getting offloaded (if applicable)

Still_getting_offloaded.description: Whether the driver is still getting offloaded from previous load

Time_until_empty.description: How long until driver will be empty from current offload (if applicable)

Tracking_started.description: Whether the driver confirmed they opened the tracking link and tracking has started

Will_be_late.description: Based on ETA vs appointment time, whether driver will be late

title: At Pickup (Pre-arrival)
voice_questions: Hi, this is Zuum calling on load ### - am I speaking with [driver name] from [carrier company]?
Have you checked in at the shipper yet? If not, what's your ETA to [pickup address]?
If still getting offloaded from previous load, ask what city/state and how long until you'll be empty to proceed to the shipper
Please confirm your tractor number, trailer number, and that you have the right equipment for this load
I've sent the Zuum tracking link - can you open it so tracking starts?
Have you already gotten a door number or are you still waiting for one?
If they have a door number, ask what door number was assigned
